Hi Evelyn and Marissa,

Thanks again for the intro meeting last week — quick follow-up with a concrete proposal. CloudPivot would like to co-run a three-city partner tour (SF, Austin, NYC) in Sep/Oct with a follow-up joint webinar to capture national leads. Objective: generate high-quality product trials and top-of-funnel pipeline for both teams while sharing costs on venue, booths, and promotion.

High-level offer:
- CloudPivot covers 40% of venue & local logistics if Redwood picks up 60% of promotion (email + paid social).
- Sponsorship tiers in the attached deck (title, gold, silver) with defined deliverables.
- Joint session + breakout with Redwood CIO/BDR presence at each city.

Attached: collab_sponsorship_deck_v3.pdf (branding, audience estimates, sponsorship matrix).

Proposed dates:
- SF: week of Sep 13
- Austin: week of Sep 27
- NYC: week of Oct 18

Would love to align on sponsorship levels, lead sharing SLA, and a rough ops timeline by next Friday (Jun 26) so we can lock venues.

Best,
Samir

4) Measurement & handoff: we need a concrete lead SLA (e.g., leads shared within 24 hours, HubSpot tags, attribution UTM plan).

We should also decide on a sponsorship matrix quickly (Title/Gold/Silver) with deliverables tied to media spend. I reviewed the deck; Marissa can propose levels and a draft co-funding table.
